scenes.title: Le point tutelle  (The Check-In)
scenes.summary: Andréa checks on Gabriel's recovery at ASK, only to discover he hid a pile of neglected files in his cupboard, including an urgent contract for Monica Bellucci.

scenes.title: Un homme normal  (A Normal Man)
scenes.summary: At ASK, superstar Monica Bellucci confesses to Gabriel that she is tired of men seeing her merely as a trophy and yearns to find a normal, authentic relationship.

scenes.title: L'eau à température ambiante  (Room-Temperature Water)
scenes.summary: While having a drink with Gabriel, Monica demonstrates her refined diva habits before visiting a neighborhood bookstore to look for Paris guides for singles.

scenes.title: La vie ordinaire  (Ordinary Life)
scenes.summary: Amused by quirky Paris guidebooks, Monica convinces Gabriel to accompany her to an ordinary gathering so she can experience authentic everyday romance.

scenes.title: Une soirée incognito  (An Incognito Evening)
scenes.summary: Gabriel takes movie star Monica Bellucci incognito to a flat party under the pseudonym Chantal so she can meet ordinary people.

scenes.title: Le choix des prénoms  (Choosing Baby Names)
scenes.summary: In bed, Andréa and Colette try to choose a baby name from their lists, but arguments about past lovers and commitment to parenthood resurface.

scenes.title: Peur de la routine  (Fear of Routine)
scenes.summary: In bed, Andréa admits her fear of domestic boredom and conventional life, but Colette reminds her that their partnership can be an exciting celebration together.

scenes.title: Fin de soirée  (End of the Evening)
scenes.summary: Gabriel walks Chantal to her entrance late at night, sharing an awkward and polite goodnight after their date.

scenes.title: Les confidences de Noémie  (Noémie's Confessions)
scenes.summary: At ASK, Hervé invites Noémie to a sold-out theater play, but Noémie reveals she cannot make it because she is still passionately dreaming about Philippe.

scenes.title: L'invitation de Monica  (Monica's Invitation)
scenes.summary: Star client Monica Bellucci calls the agency to discuss commercial ads, speaking first with Hicham before inviting Gabriel over to her home for homemade risotto.

scenes.title: L'invitation au dîner  (The Dinner Invitation)
scenes.summary: Hicham notices Andréa's physical exhaustion and invites Andréa and Colette to a gastronomic dinner to propose updates to their coparenting agreement.

scenes.title: Le dîner de coparentalité  (The Coparenting Dinner)
scenes.summary: At dinner, Hicham drops a bombshell by insisting on officially recognizing the unborn baby, devastating Colette whose future parental rights would be revoked.

scenes.title: Chez Monica Bellucci  (At Monica Bellucci's)
scenes.summary: At Monica's apartment, Monica Bellucci and Gabriel inspect retouched advertising portraits, and Monica expresses how deeply she appreciates Gabriel's gentle gaze.

scenes.title: La panique de Gabriel  (Gabriel's Panic)
scenes.summary: Pris de panique après ses avances embarrassantes chez Monica Bellucci, Gabriel s'enfuit en taxi et appelle Andréa pour lui confier son désarroi.

scenes.title: Un hérisson en boule  (A Curled-Up Hedgehog)
scenes.summary: Toujours au téléphone avec Andréa dans le taxi, Gabriel se compare à un hérisson terrorisé face à la sublime actrice et supplie son amie de l'héberger.

scenes.title: La démission de Noémie  (Noémie's Resignation)
scenes.summary: Le lendemain matin à l'agence, Noémie annonce à Mathias qu'elle a reçu une offre d'un chasseur de têtes à Boulogne et qu'elle démissionne avec effet immédiat.

scenes.title: Le mot de Monica  (Monica's Note)
scenes.summary: Gabriel arrive épuisé à l'agence et découvre ses affaires déposées par Monica avec un mot cinglant, tandis que Mathias l'interroge sur le départ de Noémie.

scenes.title: L'accident de Catherine  (Catherine's Accident)
scenes.summary: On a Paris street corner, Catherine suffers a sudden accident. Mathias rushes over as emergency services are called.

scenes.title: L'avant-première du film  (The Film Premiere)
scenes.summary: At the cinema premiere, director Julien takes the stage to introduce his bold indie film, thanking star Sofia and his dedicated agent Gabriel Sarda.

scenes.title: Une cigarette dehors  (A Cigarette Outside)
scenes.summary: Overwhelmed by her nudity on screen, Sofia slips out of the screening room into the cinema foyer, where Gabriel joins her to comfort and reassure her.

scenes.title: Une cigarette forte  (A Strong Smoke)
scenes.summary: Outside the cinema on the pavement, Hervé panics after watching the screening of his new auteur film. Trying to calm his racing anxiety, he borrows a heavy cigarette from the ticket clerk, which he shares with agent Gabriel.

scenes.title: Tout nu à l'écran  (Completely Naked on Screen)
scenes.summary: Standing outside the cinema doors, Hervé explains to Gabriel why he fled the preview screening: the art-house director eliminated every single scene where Hervé wore clothes, leaving him completely naked on screen.

scenes.title: Il tient à vous  (He Cares About You)
scenes.summary: Recovering at home after a hospital stay, assistant Noémie welcomes Mathias and his wife Catherine into her apartment. Catherine directly questions Noémie's decision to leave ASK and reveals how deeply Mathias cares about her.

scenes.title: Les aveux de Gabriel et Monika  (Gabriel and Monica's Confessions)
scenes.summary: Tard dans la soirée, Gabriel se rend chez Monica Bellucci pour lui avouer ses mensonges. Monica le réconforte et lui confie qu'elle souffre elle aussi de la solitude.

scenes.title: Le remède du célibat  (The Remedy for Being Single)
scenes.summary: Dans sa cuisine, Monica Bellucci discute avec Gabriel de la difficulté d'être célibataire. Gabriel lui révèle que l'amitié est le meilleur remède, avant que Monica ne lui prépare une infusion.

scenes.title: Si on se barrait ?  (What If We Left?)
scenes.summary: À l'agence ASK en pleine nuit, Andréa est à bout face aux pressions d'Hicham. Elle propose à Gabriel une idée audacieuse : quitter l'agence ensemble pour fonder leur propre structure.

scenes.title: Le pacte secret  (The Secret Pact)
scenes.summary: Andréa et Gabriel planifient leur départ en secret. Pour éviter toute fuite auprès d'Hicham, ils décident de boucler toutes les démarches juridiques avant d'en informer leurs acteurs.
